117748.name: Beit Jabad Tucuman
117748.note: 'Jabad Tucumán fue fundada un 4 de julio de 1982 – 12 de Tamuz del calendario hebreo, con la llegada del Rabino Israel Daniel Levy y su Esposa Miriam' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory of the interior's communities, 'Año de inauguración: 1982'; the text was supplied by the kehilá). (12 Tammuz 5742 fell on 3 July; the date is as the source has it.) Also 'El rabino Danel Levy es el director de Beit Jabad Tucuman, desde 1982' (es.chabad.org). Chabadpedia (his page): at the end of 5741, in kollel in Buenos Aires, he was offered Tucumán among other places, and the couple went after their wedding. Lamadrid 752 (Gan, Talmud Torah), Lamadrid 623 (mikvah, Centro Médico Maimónides), Lamadrid 770 (temple). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

117746.name: Beit Jabad Cordoba
117746.note: 'Inaugurado el 30 de Diciembre de 1989, el BeitJabad comenzó con un pequeño templo en la calle Faustino Allende de Barrio Cofico. En 1992, el BeitJabad mudó sus instalaciones, a un espacio mucho más grande ubicado en la calle Sucre 1378' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá). Rabbi Yossi Turk, in his own words: 'In 1989, Rabbi Zvi Grunblatt, the head shliach of Argentina, came into kollel looking for a shliach for Cordoba ... My wife, our baby, and I arrived in Cordoba in December 1989, Kislev 5750' (COLlive, 22 July 2022); 'Rabbi Yossi and Chana Turk, co-directors of Jabad Lubavitch Cordoba since 1989' (CrownHeights.info, March 2014). Its mikvah came five years after they arrived; Gan Meorot preschool in 2004. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

earlier.where: a small temple on calle Faustino Allende, Barrio Cofico

117747.name: Beit Jabad Rosario
117747.note: 'Llegamos a Rosario como emisarios del Rebe de Lubavich para fundar Beit Jabad Rosario. Mi señora Jaia Sarah Dahan yo, Shlomo Tawil, junto a mi hija Jana de 3 meses en Febrero de 1987 ... En 1988 se colocó la piedra fundamental para nuestra sede. En 1992 se inauguró la mikve y en 1994 se inauguró el resto del edificio' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá; Mendoza 1572). Also 'When Tawil arrived with his wife Chaya Sara in 1987 to establish a Chabad presence' (lubavitch.com, Sept 2005) and 'he has served as the Chabad emissary in Rosario since 1987' (COLlive and CrownHeights.info, June 2019). A branch in Puerto Norte is run by Rabbi Mendi Tawil. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

117741.name: Beit Jabad Bahia Blanca
117741.note: 'Chabad of Bahia Blanca was founded in 1985 by Rabbi Moshe and Sarah Freedman' (lubavitch.com, March 2025); 'Jabad se estableció en el 1985 con la llegada del Rabino Moshe Freedman z"l y su familia, a pedido de la Kehilá local para un Rabino ... En el 1994 se inauguró el centro del BeitJabad que sirve hasta hoy en día' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá); 'Freedman arrived there in 1985' (COLlive, Aug 2016). (CrownHeights.info, March 2018, says 'Since 1986'; COLlive, Jan 2021: the first public menorah, Chanukah 1986, came a year and three months after he arrived.) Chabadpedia (his page, no footnote): he joined the shluchim in Argentina in תשמ"ה (5745) and was sent as rabbi of Bahía Blanca's Jewish community; no Hebrew year entered, since the arrival may have been just after Rosh Hashanah 5746. Rabbi Moshe Freedman passed away on 22 Tammuz 5776 (July 2016); his son Rabbi Shmuel and Shterni Freedman came at Chanukah 2020. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

117924.name: Beit Jabad Flores
117924.note: 'היאחזות חב"ד בשכונה החלה בממדים צנועים בשנת תשנ"ב, כאשר הרב דוד פלאטקא החל לשמש בה שליח. בית-חב"ד שהקים שכן בדירה קטנה ושכורה, אך בשנת תשנ"ד התרחבה הקהילה ורכשה את בית-חב"ד הנוכחי' (Chabad in the neighbourhood began modestly in 5752, when Rabbi Dovid Plotka started as its shliach, in a small rented apartment; in 5754 the community bought its house) (COL, 4 Jan 2004, at the inauguration of its new building, a copy of 770). Chabadpedia (his page) agrees: in 5752, with the Rebbe's blessing, a Chabad house opened in Flores. His sons run Flores Norte (Andrés Lamas), Floresta and Or Sinai. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

earlier.where: a small rented apartment in Flores (5752-5754)

1025953.name: Beit Jabad Lamas (Flores)
1025953.note: 'A new Chabad House was recently inaugurated in the Flores district in Buenos Aires by Shliach Rabbi Shea Plotke. At the new impressive building, Head Shliach Rabbi Tzvi Grunblatt and Rabbi Yosef Faigelstock affixed the Mezuza. Plotke's proud father Rabbi David Plotke wished his son much success' (COLlive, 22 June 2009, 30 Sivan 5769; read through Firecrawl). Chabadpedia (Rabbi Dovid Plotka's page): his son Rabbi Yehoshua Avraham 'Shiele' Plotka is shliach in Flores Norte (Andrés Lamas). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2009-11-03.

3594421.name: Jabad Lubavitch Mar Del Plata
3594421.note: 'Chabad Opens in Mar del Plata, Argentina' (lubavitch.com, 16 Feb 2017; CrownHeights.info the same day: 'Although they first began visiting a few months back, the official opening ... was delayed due to difficulties finding housing'). 'En el 2017 Jabad Argentina anuncia con orgullo la apertura del 37° Beit Jabad. El Rabino Zalmi y Patsonia Allouche Lipinski, junto a sus dos hijas, en la ciudad de Mar del Plata' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2017-02-20.

6773118.name: Jabad Resistencia
6773118.note: Rabbi Nochum and Rivka Freedman: 'The Freedmans made their first visit over Chanukah in 2023 ... They made the move to Resistencia in the summer of 2024' (lubavitch.com, 27 May 2026). Either summer (January-March or June-August 2024) is in 5784. Rabbi Nochum Freedman is a son of Rabbi Moshe Freedman of Bahía Blanca (Chabadpedia). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2025-02-10.

706154.name: Chabad University Student Center - El Lazo
706154.note: 'In 1995, Rabbi Shlomo and Rebbetzin Rachel Levy opened what would become the first Chabad on Campus and Chabad Young Professionals center in Buenos Aires, affectionately known simply as El Lazo' (COLlive, 3 Dec 2025, at its 30-year gala). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2008-07-25. The Levys also run Beit Jabad Palermo Comunidad.

1037533.name: Escuela y Comunidad Wolfsohn Tabacinic
1037533.note: The Wolfsohn School, 'a former flagship school of Argentina's Conservative Jewish movement, which opened this week under the auspices of Chabad-Lubavitch': 'On March 7, the beginning of the academic year in Buenos Aires and only a few months since Chabad stepped in, the newly renovated building now named the Tabicinik Center for Jewish Studies—Wolfsohn School opened with 150 students' (lubavitch.com, 11 March 2005). Wolfsohn itself 'was founded in 1906 as a Jewish community library' and was the Conservative movement's flagship school until 2004; Rabbi Mendy Gurevitch and his wife came to lead its community in 2011 (CrownHeights.info, June 2015). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2009-11-10.

439472.name: Chabad-Lubavitch Puerto Madero
439472.note: 'Grunblatt announced the appointment of Rabbi and Mrs. Chayim Baruch Oirechman to Puerto Madera ... beginning with a pre-school and a shul'; with them 'the community will have its first Jewish institution' (lubavitch.com, 25 Oct 2004, 10 Cheshvan 5765). Chabadpedia (his page): 'בשנת תשס"ה יצא ביחד עם זוגתו מרת ברכה מרים ובנם מנחם מענדל לשליחות בפוארטו מאדרו' (in 5765); in 5769 the city gave it a historic 1929 building (by the architect Andrés Kálnay) for a Chabad house and community centre. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2006-10-27.

628844.name: Ieladeinu
628844.note: 'Until Ieladeinu opened its first home in 2002, Jewish children were routinely placed in government run homes' (lubavitch.com, June 2008, when UNICEF published a book on the program). Chabad of Argentina's child-care agency for children at risk; 'Rabbi Grunblatt, who founded Ieladeinu' (lubavitch.com, Jan 2009); its Perla Rohr home was dedicated in Dec 2007. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2008-01-23.

extra-argentina-beit-jana.name: Beit Jana – Centro Integral para la Mujer Judía
extra-argentina-beit-jana.note: 'Since its opening in late 2008, Beit Jana's 450 members have enjoyed the center's varied educational and recreational offerings. The five-story structure, formerly a warehouse, was remodeled for the Jewish women of this bustling Argentinean city' (lubavitch.com, 8 July 2009), with Mrs. Shterna Grunblatt, co-director of Chabad of Argentina, and Mrs. Chaya Abelson, its coordinator. Ecuador 780. Not on chabad.org.

7447577.name: Beit Jabad Santa Fe
7447577.note: 'Rabbi Shamai and Devo Chein, together with their daughter Chana, are preparing to move on shlichus to Santa Fe, Argentina ... The new shluchim will work to establish a warm address for every Yid in the city and surrounding areas' (COLlive, 22 Oct 2026). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2026-08-19, before the move (6 Elul 5786; the move is in 5787, so no Hebrew year).

118871.name: Cheder Oholey Chinuch
118871.note: At the new campus of 'the Chabad-Lubavitch Oholei Chinuch primary school for boys' (Nov 2023): 'The Buenos Aires educational hub was founded in 1974 by Rabbi Berel Baumgarten, the pioneering Chabad-Lubavitch emissary sent by the Rebbe to Argentina' ... 'It began with three students' (Chabad.org, copied by CrownHeights.info, 19 Dec 2023); 'The school began in 1974 with a total of three students' (lubavitch.com and CrownHeights.info, Nov 2021). Principal Rabbi Pinchas Chein (COLlive, Dec 2022). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

117743.name: Editorial Kehot Lubavitch Sudamericana
117743.note: Chabadpedia (Rabbi Nosson Grunblatt's page, no footnote): 'בשנת תשמ"ב פתח הרב גרינבלאט סניף קה"ת ומאז ועד היום מתרגם ועורך ספרים בספרדית' (in 5742 he opened a Kehot branch, and has translated and edited books in Spanish since). Chabadpedia alone, so low (owner, Nov 15). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

118232.name: Centro Leoded
118232.note: Chabadpedia (Rabbi Moshe Daniel Blumenfeld's page, no footnote): 'בשנת תשנ"ט עבר לגור בעיר בואנוס איירס, שם פתח את מרכז לעודד' (in 5759 he moved to Buenos Aires and opened the Leoded center, which visits Jews in hospitals); before that he was shliach in Paraná. Chabadpedia alone, so low. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

606558.name: Comedor Comunitario Beit Jabad Flores
606558.note: Chabadpedia (Rabbi Dovid Plotka's page, no footnote): 'בשנת תשס"א במהלך המשבר הכלכלי הגדול, נפתח מטבח תמחוי קהילתי ליהודים עניים באזור, הממשיך לפעול עד היום' (in 5761, in the great economic crisis, a community soup kitchen opened for the area's poor Jews). Chabadpedia alone for the year, so low. It ran by January 2004: 'ובבניין אחר פועל בקביעות בית-תמחוי' (COL, 4 Jan 2004). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-12-25.

477152.name: Jabad En La City
477152.note: 'Opening Eshel cafe has been Rabbi Jalusi's dream since he started his Chabad center downtown five and half years ago' (lubavitch.com, 6 Feb 2008; the kosher café opened in December 2007): so about August 2002 (counted back, medium). He had convinced Rabbi Tzvi Grunblatt 'to let him start a Chabad center downtown'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14.

263782.name: Beit Jabad La Plata
263782.note: 'El Beit Jabad La Plata comenzó sus actividades en Diciembre de 2003. Su director es el Rabino Tuvia Serber' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá; Calle 16 n° 732). Also 'Some 25 years ago, Chabad La Plata was founded by Rabbi Tuvia and Ilana Serber, who recently handed the reins of the organization to Rabbi Aaron and Rivky Rajchman' (lubavitch.com, 24 June 2025: a round figure). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2005-02-27.

477074.name: Chabad Lubavich Bariloche
477074.note: 'In addition to the one in Salvador, new Chabad centers have opened in Cusco, Peru; Buenos Aires and Bariloche, Argentina' (lubavitch.com, 5 Nov 2006): permanent centers for Israeli backpackers, funded by South American philanthropists after 'a Seder for hundreds of Israeli backpackers in Bariloche'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14. 'Along with his wife Shifra and seven children, Rabbi Klein has been the Chabad representative in Bariloche since 2009' (lubavitch.com, 13 May 2026).

117745.name: Chabad Lubavitch Argentina HQ
117745.note: 'Rabbi Berel Baumgarten, the pioneering Chabad-Lubavitch emissary sent by the Rebbe to Argentina, who worked tirelessly to reinvigorate the community from 1955 until his untimely passing in 1978' (Chabad.org, copied by CrownHeights.info, 19 Dec 2023); Chabad.org's 2015 history of Chabad in Argentina (Dovid Margolin; read through WebFetch) also counts from 1955. Chabadpedia differs on when he settled: from תשט"ז (5716) the Rebbe sent him to countries in Europe and South America, at first for the summer months, and only in תשי"ח (5718, 1957-58) did he move there with his family (its Argentina page; his own page has him settling in Cheshvan 5723). So 1955 for its start, medium. Rabbi Tzvi Grunblatt came in 1978 to take his place (the head shliach since). Agüero 1164. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

3418334.name: Beit Jabad Concordia
3418334.note: 'Rabbi Yisroel Soriano and his wife Chana arrived in Concordia, Argentina five years ago and immediately went to work' (COLlive, 20 March 2021): so about 2016 (counted back, medium). Its listing number (3418334, just after one made on 2016-08-17) says its chabad.org listing was first made about August 2016 (chabad.org's record shows 2018-01-29, a later republication). An earlier shlichus there had ended: 'In 1982 Rabbi Yisroel and Miriam Kapeluschnik went out on shlichus to Concordia' (COLlive, Jan 2024); Chabadpedia: from Kislev 5743, for 18 years, then Buenos Aires in 5760.
